annotations.title: 10% tax withholding without a labour contract (Vietnam)

description: Calculate the 10% personal income tax an organisation withholds from a payment to a resident individual without a labour contract or with a contract under 3 months (freelance, service fees). Threshold per payment: 2 million VND before 1 July 2026, 5 million VND from that date (the effective date of Decree 253/2026/ND-CP); below it nothing is withheld. Caveat on the date: the decree also applies its provisions on residents' salary income to the whole tax year 2026, so the 5 million threshold may be read as applying from 1 January 2026; this is not confirmed, and for January-June 2026 the tool uses 2 million and says so in the notes. Notes cover the commitment-form exemption. Examples: {"amount":8000000}; {"amount":3000000,"as_of":"2026-03-15"}.

amount.description: Amount of one payment in VND (before tax) to a resident without a labour contract or with a contract under 3 months.

as_of.description: Payment date: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

date.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

month.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.
